notes: The journal article cites the queued December 2025 ResearchGate preprint as its predecessor and repeats its core experiments. Its main comparisons are 12×12 DRL versus earlier 6×6 DRL and hybrid GA–DRL versus DRL. GA supplies a pretraining design in Figure 2, but a standalone non-learned TO optimization benchmark with an independently compared result or time is not presented. SIMP appears only as a possible future strategy, not a run.
